standard-dialogue-before-starting-family.npc: Who are you? What are you after?

options.text: Nothing, I will be on my way.

steps.player: Nothing, I will be on my way.

options.text: I see you are a chef, will you cook me anything?

steps.player: I see you are a chef... Could you cook me something?

steps.npc: I would, but I am very busy. I am trying to increase my reknown as one of the worlds' leading chefs by preparing a special and unique fish salad.

steps.text: If the player is speaking to Caleb about the quest for the first time:

steps.player: Caleb! As an adventurer, I am ready to help you with whatever you need... again! What can I help you with?

steps.text: You daydream briefly of what the rich family could offer you this time as a reward.

steps.npc: ... and that's when I found the broken lamping stick. Maybe you could help me investigate?

steps.player: Sorry, I didn't quite catch that, my mind was erm... elsewhere.

steps.npc: Well if you aren't going to listen to the problem, it's fine, don't worry about it. Nothing an experienced chef can't solve himself!

steps.player: I'm sorry! Please let me help.

steps.npc: No! Not every problem in my life needs an adventurer to come solve it for me anyway. I'm happy and there's nothing else either!

steps.player: Very well, I'll go and see if your other brothers need anything...

steps.text: The sweet smell of the great rewards that may come fades slightly.
If the player has already talked to Caleb:

steps.player: Are you sure there's nothing I can do, a chef can always do with help in their kitchen right?

steps.npc: I'm a very competent cook! I do not need your assistance [player name]. Please leave me be.
I hear you have brought the completed crest to my father. I must say, that was awfully impressive work.
Yes well... Is there anything I can help you with?

options.text: Can you change my gauntlets for me?

steps.player: Can you change my gauntlets for me?

steps.text: If the player already has a pair of cooking gauntlets:

steps.npc: Your gauntlets have already been treated with my potions.

steps.text: If the player does not have any other gauntlets on them:

steps.npc: You don't have any gauntlets I can imbue.

steps.text: If the player has another set of gauntlets on them:

steps.npc: Yes certainly, though it will cost you 25,000 coins.

steps.text: If the player does not have enough coins:
Caleb takes the gauntlets from you, pours some herbs and seasonings on them, bakes them on his range for a short time, then hands them back to you.

standard-dialogue-after-completing-famil.npc: I have received word from my father that you assisted us again! I get the feeling you weren't going to stop trying until you did though.

standard-dialogue-after-completing-famil.text: If this is the first time the player has talked to Caleb after completing Family Pest:

steps.npc: As thanks, I'll provide you with as many pairs of Cooking gauntlets as you wish.

steps.text: Caleb hands you a pair of Cooking gauntlets.

steps.npc: You will find the rate you burn certain foods is much reduced whilst wearing these gauntlets.

standard-dialogue-after-completing-famil.text: If the player has already talked to Caleb at least once after completing Family Pest:

options.text: Could I have some more cooking gauntlets, please?

steps.player: Could I have some more cooking gauntlets, please?

steps.text: How many would you like to take?
Caleb hands you some cooking gauntlets.

steps.npc: You will find the rate you burn certain foods is much reduced whilst wearing these gauntlets.
